map.输入钢丝直径、中径、有效圈数及材料，计算弹簧刚度、最大变形、剪切应力及固有频率: Enter the wire diameter, mean diameter, number of active coils and material to compute the spring stiffness, maximum deflection, shear stress and natural frequency
💡 Formula: spring index C=D/d; Wahl factor K=(4C-1)/(4C-4)+0.615/C; stiffness k=G·d⁴/(8·D³·n); shear stress τ=K·8F·D/(π·d³); maximum deflection δmax=[τ]·π·D²·n/(K·G·d)
map.旋绕比 C 通常取 4~16，过小加工困难，过大易失稳: The spring index C is usually 4-16; too small is hard to machine, too large tends to buckle
map.受变载荷的弹簧应进行疲劳强度校核，本工具按静强度计算: Springs under variable load should be checked for fatigue strength; this tool uses static strength
map.细长比（自由长度/中径）大于 3.7 时需校核失稳: When the slenderness ratio (free length / mean diameter) exceeds 3.7, buckling must be checked
map.许用应力与载荷性质有关：I类（变载荷）取低值，III类（静载荷）取高值: The allowable stress depends on the load nature: class I (variable load) takes the lower value, class III (static load) the higher value
map.固有频率约为工作频率的 10 倍以上以避免共振: The natural frequency should be more than about 10 times the working frequency to avoid resonance
map.📚 深度解析：圆柱螺旋弹簧设计: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Cylindrical Helical Spring Design
map.自由长 Lf、压实长 Ls、固有频率 fn 校核。: Free length Lf, solid length Ls and natural frequency fn checks.
Mass m=0.2 kg: fn=(1/(2π))√(k·1000/m)=(1/6.283)√(10000/0.2)=(0.159)×√50000=0.159×223.6≈35.6 Hz. The excitation frequency should be kept away to prevent resonance.
map.圆柱螺旋弹簧最大扭转剪应力（含曲度修正前的简式），d 为簧丝径、D 为弹簧中径。: The maximum torsional shear stress of a cylindrical helical spring (the simple form before curvature correction); d is the wire diameter and D the mean diameter.
map.若工作频率接近 fn 会共振放大应力，需调刚度/质量使频率比避开 1 附近。: If the working frequency approaches fn, resonance amplifies the stress; the stiffness/mass must be adjusted so the frequency ratio avoids the region near 1.
map.圆柱螺旋压缩弹簧设计计算器，依据钢丝直径、弹簧中径、有效圈数及材料参数，计算弹簧: A cylindrical helical compression spring design calculator: from the wire diameter, spring mean diameter, number of active coils and material parameters it computes the spring index, Wahl factor, stiffness, maximum deflection, shear stress, natural frequency and geometry, aiding spring parameter design and verification.
map.内置六种常用弹簧材料参数: Built-in parameters for six common spring materials
map.计算旋绕比并判定合理性: Computes the spring index and judges its reasonableness
map.输出刚度、最大载荷、固有频率: Outputs stiffness, maximum load and natural frequency
map.工作载荷下应力与安全系数校核: Stress and safety factor check under the working load
map.圆柱螺旋压缩弹簧参数设计: Cylindrical helical compression spring parameter design
